lead_with.title: Spatial data for AI models
lead_with.text: Chinh builds **autonomous R&D** (physical/agentic AI). Frame SLACS as an automated, image-guided instrument that turns tissue into **rich, location-tagged omics data** — training and validation data for Decoy's AI design engine.

lead_with.title: Where does the drug go, and which cells respond?
lead_with.text: Decoy just showed a single intranasal dose stays above antiviral levels for **up to 7 days** in upper airway and deep lung tissue. SLACS can isolate the exact epithelial regions where the drug sits and profile **which cells respond** — the next question after bulk PK.

person.name: Chinh Duong
person.text: Chemistry PhD from **Yale**. Four years at Decoy: R&D Scientist II (Oct 2022–May 2026), where he built a **modular automated lab with an AI engine** that designs and synthesizes de novo antiviral peptide conjugates; **Principal Scientist, R&D since May 2026**, building **autonomous R&D** (physical and agentic AI), data science and software for drug discovery, as team lead with several patents submitted. Helped bring Decoy into Google Cloud for AI Startups, NVIDIA Inception, GitHub/JetBrains for Startups and the **Hello Tomorrow Deep Tech Pioneer 2026** program. Also an independent quantitative researcher/investor (blockchain/web3) for ~10 years. Based in the NYC metro area, hybrid.

company.text: Decoy Therapeutics designs **peptide-conjugate therapeutics** with machine learning, AI and high-speed synthesis (IMP³ACT platform). Its product class, **Designable Multi-Antivirals (D-MAVs)**, targets fusion machinery shared across virus families (coronaviruses, flu, RSV, paramyxoviruses such as measles and Nipah). It became public by merging with Salarius Pharmaceuticals and has traded on Nasdaq as **DCOY** since Jan 8, 2026. Leadership: Rick Pierce (CEO), Dr. Barbara Hibner (CSO, co-founder), Dr. Michael Lipp (CTO, co-founder), Peter Marschel (CBO). Robert Langer (MIT) sits on its scientific advisory board. Supporters include the **Gates Foundation**, BARDA via J&J's Blue Knight, NVIDIA Inception, Google Cloud and the Massachusetts Life Sciences Seed Fund.

financials.text: **Listing:** Nasdaq: DCOY (since Jan 8, 2026; ex-Salarius SLRX). **Cash (Sep 30, 2026):** ~$8.0M, of which ~$2.5M restricted to the Gates Foundation grant. **Net loss H1 2026:** $4.6M (Q2: $2.4M). **R&D spend H1 2026:** $2.1M (Q2: $1.3M). **Recent financing:** $3.5M private placement (Jun 2026); $3.85M warrant exercise (Sep 2026). **Runway:** Into early 2027 per management; going-concern warning. Cash is tight. Pitch SLACS as a **pay-per-project service** tied to IND or grant milestones, not a platform purchase.

industry.title: Spatial biology moves into infection and tissue PK
industry.text: Spatial transcriptomics has been used to map SARS-CoV-2 infection in nasal epithelium at cell resolution — the same tissue Decoy's intranasal drug targets.

industry.title: Pandemic-preparedness money
industry.text: Decoy's Gates Foundation and BARDA-linked funding favour platforms that show broad, mechanistic data across viruses — spatial data can help make that case.

talking_points: You are building an autonomous lab — what **data types** feed your AI engine today, and is tissue-level or cell-level data part of it?
Your PK data show the drug stays in nasal and lung tissue for a week — do you know **which cell types** it sits in and how they respond?
Could image-guided, automated cell isolation (SLACS) plug into your automated workflow, or would a service model fit better?
What does the team need for the IND package in 2027 that you can't generate in-house?
Who else at Decoy (Dr. Hibner, Dr. Lipp) should see a SLACS pilot proposal?
